name: Paychex, Inc.
base_source: Latest FY2026 (first full Paycor year) OE from EDGAR 10-K: OCF $2,556.7M - capex $234.9M - SBC $96.1M = $2,225.7M / 360.0M diluted shares = $6.1825; engine 3-yr median $4.626 rejected (pre-Paycor basis break); TTM cross-check $5.41/sh (TTM OE $1,928.1M) gives Tier D at 9.1%
moat_justification: Payroll tax-compliance complexity and bundled HCM/PEO switching costs give durable recurring revenue and 40%+ margins, but ADP is larger upmarket, SMB rivals attack on price/UX, seat-based pricing is exposed to AI automation (Morningstar cut wide->narrow), and Paycor cross-sell is unproven.
one_liner: High-quality narrow-moat (6/10) payroll/HCM compounder, but at $104.64 it prices in growth it is not guiding to - weighted IRR 10.0%, IV@15% $61 vs $105 price; clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$61 (~$49 with a margin of safety).
